{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the data
sales = pd.read_csv('data/sales.csv')

# Identify QA rows: revenue = '999,999.99'
qa_rows = sales[sales['revenue'] == '999,999.99']
num_qa = len(qa_rows)

# Total completed orders (including QA)
total_completed = sales[sales['status'] == 'completed'].shape[0]

# Actual completed orders: exclude QA
actual_completed = total_completed - num_qa

# Final answer
actual_completed"}
